name: Malaysia

flag.description: Fourteen horizontal stripes alternating red and white, starting with red, and a dark blue canton containing a yellow crescent and a yellow fourteen-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: The 14 stripes and 14 star points represent the 13 states and the federal government; the crescent stands for Islam, yellow for the royal rulers and blue for the unity of the people.

hook: Malaysia looks like the US flag at first glance, but its blue corner holds a yellow crescent and a 14-pointed star instead of white stars.
trivia: The flag is called the Jalur Gemilang, "Stripes of Glory", a name given in 1997.
The star and stripes rose from 11 to 14 in 1963 to include Sabah, Sarawak and Singapore; after Singapore left in 1965, the 14th came to represent the federal government.
